newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 shut due to leak.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 shut due to leak.

text.p: The power turbine at the 1,221-megawatt (MW) Palo Verde nuclear unit 1 was shut Tuesday afternoon due to a steam leak in a small pipe, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co said.
"We had to take the turbine off-line to fix the pipe," he said, noting that the unit's reactor has not been turned off.
The spokesman estimated that the unit would begin to ramp up "within two hours to one day."
The Palo Verde unit was shut September 21 for regular refueling and maintenance. It began to ramp up to full power Friday and had reached 90 percent by early Tuesday.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221-MW units were said to be operating at normal rates.

Arizona Power, a unit of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the plant's operator and 29.1-percent owner. Other owners include Edison International's Southern California Edison Co, El Paso Electric Co and Public Service Co of New Mexico.
